styles.name: Plush
styles.description: Soft plush toy mascot with rounded stitched forms, fuzzy fabric feel, simple sewn details, and readable toy-like proportions.

instructions.materials: Use short-pile plush fabric over soft stuffing, with embroidered eyes and small sewn felt features.
instructions.forms: Build a rounded head, cushioned torso, and stubby stuffed limbs with a compact toy silhouette.
instructions.linework: Define edges through the fabric silhouette and a few curved seams, without a hard cartoon outline.
instructions.shading: Use broad diffuse cloth shading and shallow seam occlusion; keep eyes darker than nearby fabric.
instructions.palette: Choose a small set of dyed fabric colors with one restrained contrasting accessory or marking.
instructions.texture: Show a restrained fuzzy nap and two or three visible stitch runs; avoid individual flying hairs.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated sewn toy with a readable face and stable seam placement in every pose.

negative_constraints: Do not replace fuzzy cloth with shiny plastic or wet fur.
Avoid sprawling stuffing, long loose threads, and dense photoreal pile.
No scenery, floor shadows, detached decorations, clipped extremities, or changing surface motifs between animation frames.

limitations: Fine pile disappears at cell size; convey softness through broad volumes and short edge fuzz.

negative_constraints: Do not warp stitch spacing or create fractional cross stitches between frames.
